# Binder Photobooks

> Binder (binder.co.in) is a photobook printer and small publishing studio in Okhla Phase I, New Delhi, India. Customers design layflat photobooks, trade books (novels), zines and art prints in Binder's online editors, and Binder prints and ships them across India. Binder also scans old photographs and negatives and gives free ISBN guidance to self-published authors.

Key facts:
- Address: A291/1, Okhla Phase I, New Delhi 110020, India. Phone / WhatsApp: +91 70113 05116. Email: info@binder.co.in
- Photobooks: layflat binding, 250gsm matte or lustre paper; 8.5×8.5″ from ₹2,200 (20 pages), 12×12″ from ₹4,200 (20 pages), also 12×18″ portrait or landscape. No minimum order — single copies welcome.
- Trade books: 5.5×8″ perfect-bound, full-colour cover, from ₹1,000 for 100 pages. Free ISBN guidance (via the Raja Rammohun Roy National Agency).
- Zines: A5, from ₹200 for 20 pages, ₹8 per extra page.
- Art prints: set of four 6×4″ prints ₹800; single 12×18″ and 16×20″ archival prints.
- Scanning: prints, 35mm and medium-format negatives and slides at 600 DPI, pick-up and drop in Delhi NCR, minimum 100 images.
- Turnaround: 5–7 working days after the print file is confirmed (2–3 days expedited). Ships to every PIN code in India by insured courier, typically 3–5 days after dispatch; pick-up from the Okhla studio in Delhi NCR.
- Payment: cards, UPI and net banking via Razorpay; GST invoice on request. Free reprint if a book arrives damaged or below standard (report within 7 days).

## Make a book
- [Photobooks](https://www.binder.co.in/photobooks): layflat photobooks, sizes, paper and online editor
- [Wedding photobooks](https://www.binder.co.in/wedding-photobooks): wedding albums designed online and printed in Delhi
- [Trade books](https://www.binder.co.in/trade-books): printing and self-publishing novels and monographs
- [Zines](https://www.binder.co.in/zines): A5 zine printing
- [Art prints](https://www.binder.co.in/art-prints): archival art prints
- [Pricing](https://www.binder.co.in/pricing): all prices, extra pages and bulk discounts
- [Store](https://www.binder.co.in/store): ready-made books and prints for sale
